title: Share Your Story; Owen In The News
subtitle: A weekend of updates
body_html:
One of the things I've learned from in the process of being “out of the closet”— as someone with a psychiatric disorder, and for that matter an autoimmune disorder and a movement disorder—is that, in addition, to having a complicated time refilling my medicines on a monthly basis thanks to “specialty pharmacy,” sharing my story also helps other people feel seen.

There are a lot of people going through whatever you're going through, even if it's not on a percentage of the population basis, it's more people than you know, at first.

One way of answering for yourself “how alone am I?” Well, it's sharing your story.

At the company at which I work, Radial, we believe sharing your story could be a part of healing for you, but it's almost certainly an open door to healing for others. So I'm making it possible to share your story more easily. We're starting with transcranial, magnetic simulation, or TMS:

Share Your Story

Radial is collecting short videos to raise awareness about TMS and raise awareness of brain medicine’s potential, and we’d love to include your perspective.

For clinicians: Your expertise can help other clinicians better understand TMS. Answer 3 questions about why you’ve prescribed TMS for certain patients, and what you want other clinicians to know: https://vocalvideo.com/c/radial-clinician-stories

Tried TMS yourself? Your TMS story can make a real difference by helping others find the care they need. If you’re open to sharing your experience, we’d love to feature you: https://vocalvideo.com/c/radial-tms-awareness

All you do is click the link, hit record on your computer, and answer 3 questions. It takes ~5 minutes, no prep necessary. If your video is selected to be featured on Radial’s website, social media, or other marketing materials to help others discover TMS, we’ll email to let you know.

Thanks for considering joining me in demolishing stigma.

In the News

I did a talk at the American Psychiatric Association Annual Meeting 2026 recently, and there was a journalist in the room!

Here is the story she wrote about my talk, in which I discuss treatments like Proliv™ Rx and Flow’s FL-100.

In the Recovery Room

Lukas Steinbock has been a friend and on-time coworker for years now! He’s doing diligent work in the treatment of addictions. He’s got a podcast about that, and I joined him this Sunday morning.
